call.mutedTalking: You’re muted, so the agent can’t hear you.
call.soundBlocked: Tap to turn the sound back on

permission.explain: Tap the mic to start. Your browser will ask to use your microphone. We only listen during the test call.
permission.noDevice: No microphone found. Plug one in and we’ll pick it up automatically.
permission.unavailable: We couldn’t start your microphone. Another app may be using it.
permission.unsupported: This page can’t use the microphone. Open it over https in an up-to-date browser.

help.chrome: Click the icon to the left of the address bar, set Microphone to Allow, then try again.
help.firefox: Click the crossed-out microphone in the address bar, remove the block, then try again.
help.safari: Open Safari › Settings for This Website, set Microphone to Allow, then try again.
help.ios: Tap “aA” in the address bar › Website Settings › Microphone › Allow. Using another browser? Open iPhone Settings › that browser › Microphone.
help.android: Tap the icon to the left of the address bar › Permissions › Microphone › Allow, then try again.
help.other: Allow the microphone in your browser’s site settings, then try again.

network.poor: Weak connection, audio may break up
network.reconnectingHint: Hang tight, you don’t need to do anything.
